d: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav says, 'The people of Uttar Pradesh have made up their minds in favour of the Samajwadi Party.' He further said,' Let me also mention another incident. The incident is from Lakhimpur. First, the father was murdered. Later, reports emerged that his son was kidnapped, and subsequently, two minor children were found hanging from a tree. They lost their lives. The police have their own version of the story and their own side of the case. But the family members are not satisfied.
